violations.description: Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --An approved sanitizer was not used during three compartment sink operation. A sanitizer was not used during the washing of dishes and equipment. Sanitizer was not on site.
Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Boxes of straws and deli containers were stored on the floor by the back door.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was used for purpose other than handwashing. The front hand sink was used for rinsing coffee equipment. Hand sinks can not be used for any other purpose and only used for hand washing.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. Soap was not available for the hand sink.--Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Paper towels were not available for the back hand sink. The paper towels for the front sink were just placed on the counter.
